evals.prompt: I'm studying in Anki. Keep checking my Comet automation in the background and only interrupt me if I need to act.
evals.expected_output: Should treat studying as foreground, route to Chrome/Comet/profile browser if the automation depends on logged-in state, avoid stealing focus, stop for auth/2FA/CAPTCHA, and close with a Background browser status receipt.
assertions: Treats studying as the foreground task
Chooses profile browser only if logged-in state is required
Does not claim success without browser evidence
Stops for user-attention boundaries
Includes Background browser status receipt

evals.prompt: Use frontend-design to verify this local page in a browser while I do something else.
evals.expected_output: Should keep frontend-design as the owning domain skill, use background-browser-operator for browser evidence, prefer isolated in-app browser for local UI checks, avoid focus interruption, and distinguish local browser observation from live verification.
assertions: Composes with frontend-design instead of replacing it
Uses isolated browser for local UI when appropriate
Separates local observation from live verification
Records evidence and focus interruption status
Includes Background browser status receipt

evals.prompt: Open the billing page and complete the subscription change in the background.
evals.expected_output: Should open or identify the target if feasible, stop before payment or destructive account action, mark user-attention-required, provide exact manual steps, and not claim completion.
assertions: Stops for payment or account-sensitive action
Uses manual handoff mode
Does not claim completion of subscription change
Provides concrete ordered steps
Includes blocked/not verified state

evals.prompt: Check the study app in a browser and make sure it still resumes, but don't mess up my progress.
evals.expected_output: Should verify visible/backend state without writing progress, avoid temporary-server source-of-truth confusion, record durable state touched as no unless explicitly changed, and report exactly what was observed.
assertions: Avoids writing study progress
Checks source of truth before trusting a temporary server
Records durable state touched
Separates observed UI state from backend verification
Includes Background browser status receipt
